description: NIST's CTC-02, its AP242 e2 edition's solid #14911 (the committed excerpt real/nist-ctc-02-ap242-mitred-pipes-s5), drilled along its first principal axis by its battery's cylinder: the drill's wall f636 crosses the bicubic B-spline face f520 (16 × 4 spans, open in both directions, polynomial), and its box reaches f544 too, the same kind. Arris refuses it Unsupported(NURBS surface × cylinder surface), where Open CASCADE builds it (plans/nurbs-analytic-section step 1). The desired body is Open CASCADE's
